caption: The Upgrade to Pro pop-up of the Starter account with the Yearly switch on and euros chosen: Pro at 9 euro per month billed yearly (Save 12 euro) for 500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month, with the list of Pro benefits on the left. The organisation name at the top left was already covered with black by the tester. No button was clicked.

The same pop-up with US dollars chosen and the Yearly switch on (Save 10%): Pro at $9 per month billed yearly (Save $12) for 500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month, with the currency list partly open (AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP, USD). The organisation name at the top left was already covered with black by the tester.

The same pop-up after typing 2500 in the subscribers field: Pro at $18 per month billed yearly (Save $24) for 25,000 emails per month. The organisation name at the top left was already covered with black by the tester.

The pop-up Upgrade to add more forms on the Forms page, shown when a second form was started: Your Starter plan is limited to one form, with the Pro benefits and the Monthly price of 10 euro per month for 500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month. The organisation name at the top left was already covered with black by the tester.
